proposal_title: Release Version 1.0.0 Synchronization Across All Candidate Files
domain_specific_rationale: From a platform engineering, package management, and distribution perspective, consistent version string alignment across all metadata, manifests, telemetry headers, and documentation is essential to prevent build pipeline failures, contract version negotiation mismatches, and deployment confusion. Prior freeze candidates exhibited severe identity ambiguity (TECH-001 / B01) where VERSION, README.md, KIT_MANIFEST.yaml, and COMMITTEE_REVIEW_EDITION.md contained divergent version labels (v0.9.0 vs v1.0.0). CP-023 enforces synchronized release identity across all package root files, establishing '1.0.0-remediated-rc1' across candidate files and formal '1.0.0' upon freeze certification.
evidence_citations: REMEDIATION_FINDING_REGISTER.md:L99-L110 (TECH-001 root cause and resolution criteria)
capability_impact: Establishes unified platform release identity and eliminates cross-service version ambiguity across all 15 repositories, safeguarding autonomous agent handoff.
residual_risk: Downstream polyrepo packages forgetting to bump their internal package.json or pyproject.toml versions upon initial checkout. Mitigated by R15 Integration Harness validating all repo package metadata against the root VERSION string.
